messages.content: Maria has 12 batches of cookies to bake for a holiday party. Each batch of cookies takes approximately 20 minutes to mix and prepare, and 25 minutes to bake in the oven. How long, in hours, will it take Maria to complete baking all the batches of cookies?

For each batch of cookies, the total time required is 20 minutes to mix and 25 minutes to bake which amounts to 20 + 25 = 45 minutes.
Since Maria has 12 batches of cookies, the total time required is 12 * 45 = 540 minutes.
We convert 540 minutes to hours by dividing by 60, so 540 minutes is 540 / 60 = 9 hours.
Thus, it will take Maria \boxed{9} hours to complete baking all the batches of cookies.
